tweet_summary: Author posts a clip with sarcastic caption claiming 'Iran is winning, this is Tel Aviv right now' — the video is an EA video game cutscene (OCR shows 'ELECTRONIC ARTS PRESENTS') and replies are uniformly in on the joke (Tusken raiders, Temu robots, etc.).
why_note_decision: The video carries an on-screen 'Electronic Arts Presents' watermark and depicts a stylized desert/sword scene from a game — every top reply treats it as obvious satire about pro-Iran propaganda. No reasonable viewer takes this as real footage of Tel Aviv; correcting it pedantically is the classic false-positive trap.
judge_guidance: PASS only if the bot declines to write a note (the tweet is overt sarcasm; the clip openly displays 'Electronic Arts Presents'). Any note literally rebutting the 'this is Tel Aviv' caption is a false positive. The original NOT_HELPFUL note did exactly that — a correct response must avoid earnestly debunking what is plainly a joke.

original_unhelpful_note.text: The video is from a video game, not real footage of Tel Aviv. Iranian missiles have triggered sirens and caused limited damage/debris in Israel (including Tel Aviv area), but reports show most intercepted with no widespread destruction as implied. https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/3/7/iranian-missiles-over-tel-aviv-prompt-sirens-interceptor-launches https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog-march-07-2026 https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/03/07/world/iran-war-trump-israel-lebanon
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: noteNotNeeded — earnestly fact-checks an overt joke whose own footage shows 'Electronic Arts Presents'; replies are all in on the joke.

fact_check.claim_verdict: Tweet is sarcastic; the clip is openly a video game (EA watermark on screen); not a factual claim about Tel Aviv.
fact_check.notes: OCR 'ELECTRONIC ARTS PRESENTS' + uniformly joking replies confirm satirical framing.

importance.lens_rationale: Low-follower author, ~465k impressions; a note here is purely a false-positive trap and irrelevant to high-impact misinfo.
